data.one_liner: Stricter Dart analyzer linter settings and best practices as an alternative to lints.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive and stricter set of analyzer linter rules for Dart and Flutter projects. It serves as an alternative to the official lints package by enabling a wide range of best practice checks.
use_when: You want a stricter set of static analysis rules than the default lints package.
You want to enforce consistent code style and catch potential bugs early via the analyzer.
avoid_when: You prefer a very lenient linting setup without strict pedantic rules.
Your team disagrees with specific rule sets enabled by this package.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Dart linter rules with documented enablement status.
weaknesses: May require significant refactoring to satisfy strict rules on existing codebases.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev_dependency and include package:extra_pedantic/analysis_options.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.
